A.note: A's card-and-chart layout uses a green palette that varies from slide to slide, and it covers budget, programmes and next year's plan. However, the bar charts on slides 4, 5 and 7 have no labels for genre, month or survey item, so the data can't be interpreted. The titles on the cover and the final slide are dark text on a dark green background and are almost impossible to read.

B.note: B follows a report structure suited to the education office: table of contents, summary, results, budget execution, satisfaction, problems with causes and fixes, and next year's plan. It is specific throughout, with year-on-year comparisons, an execution-rate table and a quarterly plan. The design is consistent but leans heavily on tables and dark navy, and the chart text is small in places.
